subject: arabic
general_outcomes: By the end of Senior School, the learner should be able to:
Use Arabic as a communication tool through the four language skills of listening, speaking, reading and writing to meet basic and practical communication needs,
Develop an ability to speak fluently and accurately in a variety of situations,
Develop a reading culture for information and pleasure; drawing inferences and relating texts to previous knowledge; reading critically and developing the confidence to ask and answer questions,
Develop and apply skills and strategies for idea generation, selection, development and organization in writing,
Apply the grammatical rules, structures, and linguistic functions for real life purposes,
Understand and apply the overarching values and pertinent and contemporary issues embedded in the curriculum,
Realize the uniqueness of the Arabic culture, heritage and its contribution to world knowledge.

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to use vocabulary and expressions to probe and engage in oral interactions
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner uses all targeted vocabulary and expressions to probe and engage in oral interactions
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner uses some of the targeted vocabulary and expressions to probe and engage in oral interactions
assessment_rubric.below: The learner uses very few of the targeted vocabulary and expressions to probe and engage in oral interactions

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to maintain correct spoken language patterns (pronunciation, intonation, rhythm and pacing) in oral expression
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner maintains correct pronunciation, intonation, rhythm and pacing at all times in oral expression. Makes successful attempts at using colloquial and idiomatic expressions
assessment_rubric.below: The learner maintains correct pronunciation, intonation, rhythm and pacing most of the time in oral expression. Makes a few errors at times that may interfere with communication

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to respond to questions and
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner responds to all questions and prompts to
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner responds to some questions and
assessment_rubric.below: The learner responds to very few questions and

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to employ gestures and facial expressions to enhance oral interactions
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner employs adequate gestures and facial expressions in oral expressions whenever required. Is sensitive to cultural diversity and adapts non-verbal cues to diverse cultural contexts
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner employs adequate gestures and facial expressions to complement oral expressions whenever required
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner employs some gestures and facial expressions to complement oral expressions when required. A few gestures and facial expressions used do not rhyme with the intended communication
assessment_rubric.below: The learner employs a few gestures and facial expressions to complement oral expressions when required. Many of the gestures and facial expressions used do not rhyme with the intended communication

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to display willingness to participate in oral interactions
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner is always willing to start and/or participate in meaningful oral interactions with people in their surroundings. Encourages others to engage in oral interactions
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner is always willing to start and/or participate in meaningful oral interactions with people in their surroundings
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner is at times hesitant to start and/or participate in meaningful oral interactions with people in their surroundings
assessment_rubric.below: The learner is mostly hesitant to start and/or participate in meaningful oral interactions with people in their surroundings

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to pronounce words in contexts for accuracy in reading
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner maintains accurate pronunciation of words in simple texts on familiar topics to convey the intended meaning. Makes no errors of pronunciation even for texts on unfamiliar topics.
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner maintains accurate pronunciation of words in simple texts on familiar topics to convey the intended meaning.
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner makes a few errors of pronunciation of words in simple texts on familiar topics. Errors may hamper the ability to convey the intended meaning.
assessment_rubric.below: The learner makes many errors of pronunciation of words in simple texts on familiar topics. Errors greatly hamper the ability to convey the intended meaning.

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to read with fluency (smoothness, pace, pauses and intonation)
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner reads simple texts with natural and smooth flow and at an appropriate pace all through. Pays attention to all punctuations and applies appropriate
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner reads simple texts with natural and smooth flow and at an appropriate pace all through. Pays attention to all punctuations and applies appropriate pauses and intonation to express intention and emotions.
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner reads simple texts with natural and smooth flow and at an appropriate pace through most parts of the texts. Pays attention to most of the punctuations and applies appropriate pauses and intonation to express
assessment_rubric.below: The learner reads simple texts with stilted and choppy flow through most parts of the texts. Pays attention to very little punctuation as pauses and

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to read and understand simple texts
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner interprets all questions in context and gives correct answers to all the questions. Uses extensive vocabulary in giving responses to questions.
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner interprets all questions in context and gives correct answers to all the questions. Uses adequate vocabulary in giving responses to questions.
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner interprets most of the questions in context and gives correct answers to most of them. Vocabulary used in giving responses to questions is mostly sufficient with limited errors.
assessment_rubric.below: The learner interprets few questions in context and gives correct answers to a few of them. Vocabulary used in giving responses to questions is insufficient.

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to write clear and readable texts
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner writes readable texts paying attention to neatness all through. Letters in all the words are correctly spaced and sized within the lines. Words are correctly spaced within sentences all through. Text looks like a typed Microsoft office word document.
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner writes readable texts paying attention to neatness all through. Letters in all the words are correctly spaced and sized within the lines. Words are correctly spaced within sentences all through.
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner writes readable texts paying attention to neatness in most parts of the text. Letters in most of the words are correctly spaced and sized within the lines. Some abnormal spacing of words within sentences is visible.
assessment_rubric.below: The learner writes texts that are not easily readable. Neatness is not maintained all through. Letters in most of the words are incorrectly spaced and sized within the lines. Frequent abnormal spacing of words within sentences is visible.

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to organize ideas in texts
assessment_rubric.exceeds: Exhibits a logical and coherent sequence throughout; provides a clear sense of a beginning, middle, and end. Makes smooth transitions between ideas.
assessment_rubric.meets: Exhibits a logical sequence; provides a beginning, middle, and end
assessment_rubric.approaches: Attempts to provide a logical sequence and/or the beginning or ending is abrupt or unclear.
assessment_rubric.below: Exhibits little order; provides a series of separate sentence and/or disconnected ideas.

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to use vocabulary in texts
assessment_rubric.exceeds: Includes a wide variety of vocabulary that expands the topic, but there may be minor inaccuracies.
assessment_rubric.meets: Includes a variety of vocabulary related to the topic.
assessment_rubric.approaches: Includes basic vocabulary; some vocabulary may be inaccurate or unrelated to the topic.
assessment_rubric.below: Includes limited vocabulary and/or most vocabulary is inaccurate or unrelated to the topic.

Digital literacy: This is enhanced as the learner interacts with digital technology when searching online for texts containing demonstrative pronouns and interrogative articles.

substrands.name: Word class
